title: Accessibility Gate Dev Realisation Evidence
authorityBoundary: Lower-authority supporting map for USF-1072. It records the result of a LOCAL, STATIC-SEMANTICS, fail-closed dev gate that reads the recorded ui-semantic-model and checks that each declared interactive surface and component carries accessible-name, role, and keyboard semantics plus non-visual error and state semantics. It is NOT a human WCAG audit, NOT a browser or axe-core runtime accessibility run, and it does not assert product-surface UI readiness, human accessibility acceptance, or WCAG conformance. Higher authorities are the ui-semantic-model instances, the ui-semantic-model schema, and the accessibility-a11y-gate semantic contract; this map and any generated report over it are lower authority.

currentMainFreshness.note: Surfaces and component refs are re-derived from the live ui-semantic-model instances at HEAD by the validator; this document holds no independent surface authority and is re-validated on every run.

accessibilityRuleSet.description: Every interactive control recorded for the surface has a programmatic accessible name in the ui-semantic-model.
The surface declares a semantic UI role / landmark identity (uiKind, surface, route) rather than a purely visual identity.
Keyboard interaction is recorded as reaching the surface's interactive actions.
Error and auth-error states are recorded as announced without relying on visual styling only.
Denied / forbidden state is recorded as communicated without relying on colour or layout alone.

staticEvidence.a11y-static-accessible-name: ui-semantic-model records: login controls have programmatic names; auth-error retry control has an accessible name (covers componentRefs submit-login, retry-login, query-session, attempt-permission-gated-action).
staticEvidence.a11y-static-role-landmark: ui-semantic-model records uiKind=journey, surface=authentication, route=/login as the surface's semantic identity rather than a visual-only identity.
staticEvidence.a11y-static-keyboard-reachability: ui-semantic-model records: keyboard interaction reaches login and retry actions.
staticEvidence.a11y-static-nonvisual-error-announcement: ui-semantic-model records: error state is announced without relying on visual styling only; the auth-error-retry journey announces error without visual-only signalling.
staticEvidence.a11y-static-nonvisual-state-distinction: ui-semantic-model records: forbidden state communicates denied access without relying on colour or layout only.

surfaces.deferralNote: These are runtime accessibility checks that require a rendered browser surface (axe-core, real focus order, screen-reader announcement, measured contrast ratio). They belong to the test rung per the accessibility-a11y-gate semantic contract and are recorded here as gaps in dev coverage, not as dev-proven.

summary.note: One ui-semantic-model instance is recorded (ui.authentication-login); the gate applies five static-semantics rules across it and its four interactive component refs, and records four runtime checks as test-rung deferrals.
